_doc: Advanced place registry, shared by the Visual Director (src/lib/place-spec.ts), the worker (build-manifest.py) and the renderer (place_spec.py). A dressing entry is usable only when registry-audit.json holds a passing local render check for its exact definition (registry_check.py).

mountain_pass.label: narrow pass or road between steep mountains

plain.label: open plain, steppe or flat battlefield

river_crossing.label: river with banks, ford or crossing point

camp.label: army camp with tents and fires

desert.label: desert, dunes, dry badlands or oasis

snow_mountain.label: snowy mountains, arctic or winter wilderness

coast.label: seashore, harbour, port or open sea with a beach

jungle.label: dense jungle, tropical or swampy forest

ancient_city.label: ancient city, temple plaza, ruins or old stone town

town_street.label: a small town or city street with buildings, sidewalks, street lights and parked cars

road.label: an open road or highway with lane markings, cars, trees and fields

garden.label: a garden or backyard with a fence, flower beds, a bench and trees

school.label: a classroom with a blackboard, desks, chairs and bookcases

house.label: a living room or home interior with a sofa, a TV, a rug, lamps and plants

party.label: a birthday or party room with a table, a cake, balloons, presents and string lights

garage.label: a garage or workshop with a car, a workbench, shelves, tires and tools

sky.label: open sky above the clouds, for flight, weather and space-edge scenes

cozy_house.label: a small cozy house with a fence, flower beds, a tree and a path

luxury_house.label: a modern luxury house with glass walls, a pool, palms and a sports car

mansion.label: a huge mansion with columns, a fountain, hedges, a gate and luxury cars

bedroom.label: a bedroom with a double bed, a nightstand lamp, a wardrobe, a rug and a window

kitchen.label: a kitchen and dining room with cabinets, a fridge, a stove and a dining table with chairs

rooftop.label: an apartment balcony or rooftop with a railing, chairs, plants, string lights and a city skyline

village_life.label: a cosy village with cottages, a well, a windmill, hay bales, fences and a dirt road

lowpoly_city.label: a colourful low-poly city with towers, streets, cars and trees

cyberpunk_alley.label: a neon-lit cyberpunk alley at night with signs, pipes, steam, wet ground and tall dark towers

shop.label: a convenience store or shopping mall shop with shelves of goods, a counter, fridges and a neon sign

countryside_road.label: a quiet countryside road between fields with a barn, fences, trees and hills

highway.label: a wide multi-lane highway with cars, trucks, lamp posts, road signs and barriers

train_station.label: a train station with a platform, rails, a train, benches, lamps and a sign

bus_stop.label: a bus stop with a shelter, a bench, a bus, lamp posts and trees

school_hallway.label: a school hallway with rows of lockers, doors, benches and a trophy shelf

playground.label: a playground in a park with swings, a slide, a seesaw, a sandbox, benches and trees

hospital.label: a hospital room with a bed, a heart monitor, an IV stand, a curtain and a window

office_cubicles.label: an open office with cubicles, desks, computers, a water cooler and plants

boardroom.label: a boardroom with a long table, chairs, a screen and a window

courtroom.label: a courtroom with a judge bench, a witness stand, gallery benches, a flag and wood panelling

interrogation.label: an interrogation room with a bare table, two chairs, a hanging lamp and a dark one-way mirror

war_zone.label: a ruined war zone with sandbags, tents, barrels, barbed fences, burning wrecks and smoke

throne_room.label: a medieval castle throne room with a golden throne, a red carpet, stone columns, banners and torches

deep_forest.label: a deep forest with tall trees, ferns, mushrooms, logs, rocks and shafts of light

beach.label: a tropical beach island with sand, palm trees, an umbrella, a boat, rocks and the sea

mountain_cliff.label: a rugged mountain cliffside with rock walls, pines, boulders, snow and a narrow path

desert_canyon.label: a desert canyon with red rock walls, cacti, dunes, bones and a pyramid on the horizon

space_station.label: a space station interior with metal floor panels, computer consoles, display walls, pipes and a window onto a planet

alien_planet.label: an alien planet with purple rock, glowing crystals, strange plants, a crashed spaceship and two moons

haunted_house.label: a haunted abandoned house at night with a graveyard, broken fences, dead trees, fog and glowing windows

gym.label: a gym with treadmills, weights, a bench press, mirrors and a boxing ring

stadium.label: a sports stadium with a grass pitch, white lines, goals, stands full of seats and floodlights
